compose:
services:
  web:
    image: nginx:1.27-alpine
    ports: ["8080:80"]
    volumes:
      - site:/usr/share/nginx/html
      - ./conf:/etc/nginx/conf.d:ro
    environment:
      GREETING: ${GREETING}
  cache:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    volumes: [cache-data:/data]
volumes:
  site:
  cache-data:
